editorial.blurb: A Chicago institution since 1984, Shaw's Crab House delivers pristine, impeccably fresh seafood in a timeless East Coast–style setting where knowledgeable service and graceful hospitality are as much a part of the experience as the food itself.
editorial.insiderTip: The oyster bar side takes walk-ins and offers a more casual, lively way to experience Shaw's without a reservation—perfect for a spontaneous evening of raw bar bites and cocktails.

topDishes.note: Meaty, succulent, cooked perfectly—the highlight of the meal
Sweet, clean, and a showstopper for shared occasions
Minimal filler, properly crusted, with excellent remoulade
